import sys, json, struct, subprocess

from wire import packet, payload, seal

def reseal(g):
    g=bytearray(g); g[24:26]=b'\x00\x00'
    tot=sum(struct.unpack('!10H',bytes(g[14:34])))
    while tot>>16: tot=(tot&65535)+(tot>>16)
    g[24:26]=struct.pack('!H',(~tot)&65535)
    return seal(bytes(g[:-4])+b'\0'*4)

    g=bytearray(base)
    for off,val in kw.items(): g[off:off+len(val)]=val
